description: This file defines a CartService class for managing shopping cart operations such as creating carts, computing totals, adding/updating/removing items, and clearing the cart. It interacts with a database via SQLAlchemy models and sessions.

classes.name: CartService
classes.description: Service class for managing shopping cart content and totals, providing methods for cart creation, retrieval, total calculation, item management, and cart clearing.

methods.name: __init__(self, db: Session)
methods.description: Initializes CartService with a database session.

methods.name: models.Cart get_or_create_cart(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an existing cart for a user or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: Decimal compute_total(self, cart: models.Cart)
methods.description: Calculates the total price of items in a cart.

methods.name: get_or_create_cart_with_total(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cart and computes its total amount.

methods.name: add_or_update_item(self, user_id: int, product_id: int, quantity: int, replace: bool = False)
methods.description: Adds a new item to the cart or updates the quantity of an existing item.

methods.name: remove_item(self, user_id: int, product_id: int)
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart.

methods.name: clear_cart(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Removes all items from the cart.

ctags.name: add_or_update_item
ctags.pattern: /^    def add_or_update_item(self, user_id: int, product_id: int, quantity: int, replace: bool = F/
ctags.signature: (self, user_id: int, product_id: int, quantity: int, replace: bool = False)

ctags.name: remove_item
ctags.pattern: /^    def remove_item(self, user_id: int, product_id: int):$/
